extraction  -->  select beased on T-task  == grand father and and feature.names %in% word_type


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library("duckdb")

pacman::p_load(stringr, tidyverse, gtsummary, ggplot2, GGally, vtable, grid, gridExtra, diffdf, corrplot, broom, purrr, varhandle)

con <- dbConnect(duckdb(peter_file))

```

#get list of words -> word_type
```{r}
word_type <- c( "participant_nouns_freq", "participant_base_verbs_freq", "participant_pasttense_verbs_freq", "participant_gerund_verbs_freq", "participant_pastpart_verbs_freq", "participant_non3rd_verbs_freq", "participant_3rd_verbs_freq", "participant_tos_freq", "participant_adverbs_freq", "participant_adjectives_freq", "participant_modals_freq", "participant_coord_conj_freq", "participant_cardinals_freq", "participant_particles_freq", "participant_personal_pronouns_freq", "participant_wh_adverbs_freq" ,"participant_poss_pronouns_freq", "participant_wh_determiners_freq", "participant_predeterminers_freq", "participant_interjections_freq")

```

#get data set -> gf_word_type
```{r}
gf_word_type <- nlp_table %>% 
  filter(T_Task == "grandfather") %>%
  filter(feature.name  %in% word_type) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(E_Environment)) %>%
  collect %>% 
  group_by(feature.name)  
```
# get demo -> tbl_demographics
```{r}
tbl_demographics <- tbl(con,"visits_core") %>% 
  select(ptid, visit_id,  race, eth, age, gender, visit_type, visit_date, medicaid, diagnosis) %>%
  collect 
```

# clean up demo -> demographics 
```{r}
demographics <- tbl_demographics %>% 
  replace_gender(gender)%>%
  replace_race(race) %>%
  replace_eth(eth) %>% 
  extract_unique_id(visit_id) %>%
  replace_medicaid(medicaid) %>%
  further_diagnosis(diagnosis) %>%
  enumerate_diagnosis(further_diag) 
  
demographics <- demographics %>% 
  fill_in(gender, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(eth, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(race, new_id) %>% 
  fill_in(medicaid, new_id) %>% 
  mutate(age  = as.integer(age)) %>% 
  select(-c(shape, shape_num, diagnosis, medicaid, ptid))
```

#pivot wider-> gf_wider
```{r}
gf_word_type <- gf_word_type %>% 
  mutate(new_name =  paste(feature.name, crampingtexs.data, sep ="_" )) %>% 
  arrange(desc(crampingtexs.data))
gf_wider <- gf_word_type %>% pivot_wider( id_cols =  c(visit_id ),
                                         names_from = new_name,
                                         values_from = value)
```

#innerjoin on gf wider -> gf_demo
```{r}
gf_demo <- inner_join(gf_wider, demographics, by =  "visit_id")
```
